capabilities: Aggregate highlights from Markdown, PDF, and EPUB into navigable sidebar cards
Highlight and annotate text inside built-in PDF and EPUB readers
Generate and edit mind maps from highlight cards
Review cards as flashcards with FSRS spaced-repetition scheduling
Translate highlights and chat with a configured AI model about selected cards
disambiguation: Not just a text-highlighting tool; it is a reading and review suite with PDF/EPUB readers, mind maps, a bookshelf, and spaced repetition.
extras: Manual installation is listed as the recommended method; the plugin is unreviewed by Obsidian staff per its manifest; AI features need a configured provider; cross-device sync works through a vault JSON file synced by iCloud or Obsidian Sync; an optional AI-agent skill (pandora-hilight) can highlight whole documents.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect, organize, and review highlights scattered across Markdown notes, PDFs, and EPUB files.
